lead.headline: FinCEN Withdraws Crypto Mixer Rule as Regulatory Pendulum Swings Sharply Toward Deregulation
lead.tldr: The Trump Administration's deregulatory agenda is rapidly reshaping crypto's regulatory perimeter, with FinCEN retreating from mixer rules while the CFTC and SEC attempt to fill the legislative vacuum with existing authorities—creating a window for institutional experiments like tokenized equities to advance with reduced compliance friction.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief tracks a rare regulatory retreat that is already redirecting capital toward products previously stranded in compliance uncertainty.

top_signals.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBTZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.
top_signals.summary: On-chain sleuth ZachXBT exposed a Chinese crime network that laundered over $1 billion for the North Korean Lazarus Group. The investigation involved infiltrating the network to trace funds originating from a $1.5 billion hack of Bybit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The scale of state-affiliated laundering infrastructure exposed by ZachXBT—over $1 billion in traced flows—demonstrates that on-chain surveillance capabilities now rival traditional financial intelligence, raising the bar for compliance tech as a venture category and exposing the operational security gaps that persist even in mature exchanges.

top_signals.title: FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto mixing rule over ‘legitimate activity’ concerns26m, FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto mixing rule over ‘legitimate activity’ concernsThe bureau under the US Treasury said it was withdrawing two proposed rules on unhosted wallets and crypto mixers ”as part of the Trump Administration’s deregulatory agenda.”
top_signals.summary: FinCEN has withdrawn proposed rules targeting crypto mixers and unhosted wallets as part of the Trump Administration's deregulatory push. The decision follows concerns regarding the impact on legitimate financial activities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: FinCEN's withdrawal eliminates a near-term compliance overhang for privacy-preserving protocols and self-custody wallets, repricing the regulatory risk curve for US-facing infrastructure plays and likely accelerating product roadmaps that had been paused pending rule finalization.

top_signals.title: CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto framework after failed CLARITY vote42m, CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto framework after failed CLARITY voteCFTC Chair Michael Selig claimed that the agency was using its “existing statutory authorities“ to address crypto regulation after Congress failed to advance a market structure bill.
top_signals.summary: The CFTC is joining the SEC in proposing a regulatory framework for crypto assets following the failure of the CLARITY act in Congress. CFTC Chair Michael Selig stated the agency will utilize existing statutory authorities to regulate the market in the absence of new legislation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The CFTC-SEC parallel framework push reveals both agencies' urgency to define jurisdictional boundaries before Congress returns, creating a narrow window for industry participants to shape enforcement precedent through comment processes and early engagement.

top_signals.title: NYSE owner and crypto exchange OKX seek SEC clearance for tokenized U.S. stock trading
top_signals.summary: The owner of the New York Stock Exchange and crypto exchange OKX are seeking SEC approval to enable the trading of tokenized U.S. stocks. The initiative is being led by OKXICE, which recently appointed former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo as co-chair.
top_signals.why_it_matters: ICE's partnership with OKX for tokenized stock trading signals that incumbent exchange operators now view crypto rails as a credible channel for equity market structure innovation, with Andrew Cuomo's appointment as co-chair suggesting the regulatory lobbying intensity this initiative will require.

top_signals.title: OKX debuts a platform that turns 50 currencies into digital dollars, betting emerging market investors want stablecoins
top_signals.summary: OKX has launched a new platform designed to convert 50 different currencies into digital dollars. The initiative targets investors in emerging markets by addressing settlement gaps through the use of stablecoins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: OKX's 50-currency stablecoin conversion platform targets the core pain point in emerging market capital flows—FX settlement friction—positioning stablecoins as a competing infrastructure layer to correspondent banking rather than merely a crypto on-ramp.

deals.summary: Umia has raised $6.1 million through a token auction to assist crypto projects with token launches. The auction sold 34.6% of the total supply at an $18 million fully diluted valuation.

Michael Saylor's Strategy has increased its Bitcoin holdings by purchasing an additional 334 BTC for approximately $28.7 million. This latest acquisition brings the company's total holdings to over 848,000 BTC.

Veremark, a startup valued at $100m, has utilized the London Stock Exchange's new Private Securities Market to conduct an auction. This highlights the growing trend of digitizing and streamlining private equity liquidity through institutional platforms.

on_the_radar.title: S&P Global brings risk assessments to growing crypto lending vault sector24m
on_the_radar.summary: S&P Global is introducing risk assessment frameworks for the crypto lending vault sector to improve transparency and stability. This move signals increasing institutional integration and the application of traditional financial standards to decentralized lending.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC proposes new federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading
on_the_radar.summary: The CFTC has proposed a new federal framework and a specific 'crypto asset market' exchange category for leveraged retail crypto trading. However, the agency noted it lacks the congressional authority to mandate that all crypto trading occur on CFTC-regulated platforms.

on_the_radar.title: China P2P stablecoin wallets grew 43x despite crypto restrictions: Chainalysis
on_the_radar.summary: Chainalysis reports a 43-fold increase in stablecoin P2P wallet activity in China over the last two years. This growth indicates a shift toward direct transfers as users bypass longstanding national crypto restrictions.

on_the_radar.title: OKX eyes emerging markets with yield-offering stablecoin savings and payments app
on_the_radar.summary: OKX is expanding its reach into emerging markets by launching a dedicated stablecoin savings and payments application. The app will allow users to earn up to 10% APY on their USDG balances.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
on_the_radar.summary: The Fairshake PAC has announced its support for 32 House of Representatives candidates for the 2026 US midterm elections. The initiative aims to ensure a pro-crypto legislative environment in the US Congress.

on_the_radar.title: Modern Treasury seeks US trust bank charter for digital asset custody23m, Modern Treasury seeks US trust bank charter for digital asset custodyThe payments infrastructure company is seeking federal approval to offer stablecoin custody and related fiat services through a limited-purpose national trust bank.
on_the_radar.summary: Modern Treasury is applying for a US limited-purpose national trust bank charter to provide digital asset custody. This move aims to integrate stablecoin custody and fiat services directly into their payments infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: How Hyperliquid defied crypto’s DAT death spiral—and built the industry’s only flourishing digital asset treasury
on_the_radar.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies has successfully built a flourishing digital asset treasury, avoiding the common 'death spiral' associated with many crypto treasuries. The entity has amassed over 35 million HYPE tokens within a ten-month period.

on_the_radar.title: Metaplanet reveals net income strategy to fuel Bitcoin accumulation26m, Metaplanet reveals net income strategy to fuel Bitcoin accumulation
on_the_radar.summary: Metaplanet has announced a strategic plan to utilize its net income to further increase its Bitcoin holdings. This move signals the company's commitment to adopting a Bitcoin-centric treasury strategy similar to MicroStrategy.

linkedin_post:
FinCEN killed its mixer rule today. Not modified—withdrawn. The Trump Administration's deregulatory agenda is moving faster than most operators priced in.

This matters differently for different stacks. Privacy protocols just saw their US compliance risk repriced downward. Self-custody wallet builders can resume roadmaps that had been in regulatory limbo since 2020. The signal is unambiguous: the perimeter is contracting, not expanding.

Meanwhile the CFTC and SEC are both rushing framework proposals through existing statutory authorities after the CLARITY Act stalled. That's not coordination—that's a jurisdictional land grab in the legislative vacuum. For founders, the game becomes predicting which agency captures your asset class before the other one does.

ICE and OKX filed for tokenized US stock trading the same day. Not coincidental timing. Andrew Cuomo as co-chair of OKXICE telegraphs the lobbying intensity required, but the product thesis is straightforward: settlement rails that operate 24/7 with T+0 finality. The question is whether the SEC clearance process moves fast enough to beat traditional market operators building parallel infrastructure.

OKX's fifty-currency stablecoin platform is the other side of this. Emerging market FX friction is a trillion-dollar problem that correspondent banking has solved poorly and expensively. Stablecoins are now being positioned as infrastructure competition, not crypto speculation.

The throughline: regulatory retreat is creating product windows that close when clarity returns. The value capture goes to teams that ship during ambiguity.

We're watching which frameworks get comments filed, and which products launch before the comments close.
